title: P1 material: albedo vs f64 quadrature, energy <= 1, sampler weights, reciprocity, support, chi-square

tol.derivation: albedo: |E[w] - E_ref| <= max(5 se_robust, albedo_floor) (Bonferroni over 768 tests; se_robust takes the invalid-sample share at its Wilson 95% upper bound, since smooth lobes see ~1e-4 invalid samples and a direction can draw none; the adaptive-quadrature reference agrees with an independent slope-space integral to 1e-7, the Kelemen table enters both sides identically)
tol.source: f64 reference src/oracle/ref_bsdf.ts; Wilson 1927; Veach 1997 ch. 6

albedo_floor.derivation: f32 block sums of 256 weights carry <= 256u = 3e-5 relative error and the reference 1e-7; the floor only binds where 5 se_robust < 2e-4
albedo_floor.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

retest_factor.derivation: a 5-sigma exceedance (A1 or A2) is re-measured with 16x the samples, the first blocks included: a bias grows 4x in z, a heavy-tail outlier shrinks 4x (coat_r06 seed 2404: -5.55 -> -0.52; 48 other seeds: max |z| 3.82)
retest_factor.source: two-stage re-measurement; numbers measured on the reference substrate, docs/P1-01-design.md R16

weight_rel.derivation: the same ~40-operation expression compiled at two call sites may round differently (divisions 2.5 ulp, reassociation allowed: WGSL §15.7.4, §15.7.5); D takes sin^2 from the tangent components, so it does not cancel near the normal
weight_rel.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

reciprocity_rel.derivation: dot(wo, h) and dot(wi, h) round separately (<= 6u apart) and enter F; |F'| / F reaches ~10 for ior 1.5 near grazing
reciprocity_rel.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

length.derivation: wi = 2 (wo.h) h - wo with |h|, |wo| = 1 +- 2u; the cosine-lobe sample as in G12 (sin / cos to ~1 ulp on the reference substrate, WGSL guarantees only 2^-11)
length.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

chi2_p.derivation: chi-square p-value floor, deterministic under the fixed seed
